description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayBootstrapAuth component of the ai.openclaw.app project. It tests various authentication scenarios for gateway connection, including handling bootstrap tokens, shared tokens, trust prompts, and TLS fingerprint validations. The tests utilize Robolectric for Android unit testing, and involve interactions with shared preferences, runtime connection setup, and prompt handling.

classes.name: GatewayBootstrapAuthTest
classes.description: A test suite for the Gateway bootstrap authentication logic in the app, covering token handling, trust prompts, and TLS validation scenarios.
